0622-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Although ancient people apparently built it by working with clay, the source of its energy is unclear.
0622-normal-shadow.name: Golett (Shadow)

0623-normal.flavor_text: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
0623-normal.name: Golurk

0623-normal-shadow.flavor_text: When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages indiscriminately, turning the whole town around it into a mountain of rubble.
0623-normal-shadow.name: Golurk (Shadow)

0624-normal.flavor_text: It follows Bisharp's orders to a tee when it attacks enemies. After slashing an opponent, Pawniard clangs both of its blades together.
0624-normal.name: Pawniard

0625-normal.flavor_text: It leads a group of Pawniard. Bisharp doesn't even change its expression when it deals the finishing blow to an opponent.
0625-normal.name: Bisharp

0626-normal.flavor_text: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
0626-normal.name: Bouffalant

0627-normal.flavor_text: Known as a natural-born warrior, soon after its hatching, it will challenge its parent to a fight in order to gain their acceptance.
0627-normal.name: Rufflet

0628-hisuian.flavor_text: Known as “the hero of the skies," this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.
0628-hisuian.name: Braviary (Hisuian)

0628-normal.flavor_text: Known as “the hero of the skies," this Pokémon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.
0628-normal.name: Braviary

0629-normal.flavor_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
0629-normal.name: Vullaby

0630-normal.flavor_text: It's always searching for food for Vullaby. When it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it right off to its nest.
0630-normal.name: Mandibuzz

0631-normal.flavor_text: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. It melts Durant and eats them.
0631-normal.name: Heatmor

0632-normal.flavor_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
0632-normal.name: Durant

0633-normal.flavor_text: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
0633-normal.name: Deino

0633-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.
0633-normal-shadow.name: Deino (Shadow)

0634-normal.flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
0634-normal.name: Zweilous

0634-normal-shadow.flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
0634-normal-shadow.name: Zweilous (Shadow)

0635-normal.flavor_text: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

0635-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!
0635-normal-shadow.name: Hydreigon (Shadow)

0636-normal.flavor_text: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
0636-normal.name: Larvesta

0637-normal.flavor_text: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
0637-normal.name: Volcarona

0638-normal.flavor_text: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.
0638-normal.name: Cobalion

0639-normal.flavor_text: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.
0639-normal.name: Terrakion

0640-normal.flavor_text: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
0640-normal.name: Virizion

0641-incarnate.flavor_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

0643-normal.flavor_text: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

0645-incarnate.flavor_text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

0646-white.name: Kyurem (White)

0647-resolute.flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

0648-pirouette.flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
0648-pirouette.name: Meloetta (Pirouette)

0649-chill.flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
0649-chill.name: Genesect (Chill)

0649-shock.flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
0649-shock.name: Genesect (Shock)

0650-normal.flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
0650-normal.name: Chespin

0650-normal-shadow.flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
0650-normal-shadow.name: Chespin (Shadow)

0651-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators' attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
0651-normal-shadow.name: Quilladin (Shadow)

0652-mega.flavor_text: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
0652-mega.name: Chesnaught (Mega)

0652-normal.flavor_text: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
0652-normal.name: Chesnaught

0652-normal-shadow.name: Chesnaught (Shadow)

0653-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
0653-normal-shadow.name: Fennekin (Shadow)

0654-normal.flavor_text: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

0654-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
0654-normal-shadow.name: Braixen (Shadow)

0655-mega.flavor_text: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
0655-mega.name: Delphox (Mega)

0655-normal.flavor_text: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
0655-normal.name: Delphox

0655-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
0655-normal-shadow.name: Delphox (Shadow)

0656-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
0656-normal-shadow.name: Froakie (Shadow)

0657-normal.flavor_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
0657-normal.name: Frogadier

0657-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
0657-normal-shadow.name: Frogadier (Shadow)

0658-mega.flavor_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
0658-mega.name: Greninja (Mega)

0658-normal.flavor_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
0658-normal.name: Greninja

0658-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
0658-normal-shadow.name: Greninja (Shadow)

0659-normal.flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
0659-normal.name: Bunnelby

0659-normal-shadow.flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
0659-normal-shadow.name: Bunnelby (Shadow)

0660-normal.flavor_text: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
0660-normal.name: Diggersby

0660-normal-shadow.flavor_text: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
0660-normal-shadow.name: Diggersby (Shadow)

0661-normal.flavor_text: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
0661-normal.name: Fletchling

0661-normal-shadow.flavor_text: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
0661-normal-shadow.name: Fletchling (Shadow)

0662-normal.flavor_text: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
0662-normal.name: Fletchinder

0662-normal-shadow.flavor_text: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
0662-normal-shadow.name: Fletchinder (Shadow)

0663-normal.flavor_text: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
0663-normal.name: Talonflame

0663-normal-shadow.flavor_text: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
0663-normal-shadow.name: Talonflame (Shadow)

0664-normal.flavor_text: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
0664-normal.name: Scatterbug

0665-normal.flavor_text: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
0665-normal.name: Spewpa

0666-normal.flavor_text: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
0666-normal.name: Vivillon

0667-normal.flavor_text: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
0667-normal.name: Litleo

0668-normal.flavor_text: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
0668-normal.name: Pyroar

0669-normal.flavor_text: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
0669-normal.name: Flabebe

0670-normal.flavor_text: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

0671-normal.flavor_text: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
0671-normal.name: Florges

0672-normal.flavor_text: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
0672-normal.name: Skiddo

0673-normal.flavor_text: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
0673-normal.name: Gogoat

0674-normal.flavor_text: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
0674-normal.name: Pancham

0675-normal.flavor_text: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
0675-normal.name: Pangoro

0676-normal.flavor_text: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
0676-normal.name: Furfrou

0677-normal.flavor_text: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
0677-normal.name: Espurr

0678-female.flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
0678-female.name: Meowstic (Female)

0678-male.flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
0678-male.name: Meowstic (Male)

0679-normal.flavor_text: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
0679-normal.name: Honedge

0680-normal.flavor_text: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
0680-normal.name: Doublade

0681-blade.flavor_text: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
0681-blade.name: Aegislash (Blade)

0681-shield.flavor_text: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
0681-shield.name: Aegislash (Shield)

0682-normal.flavor_text: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
0682-normal.name: Spritzee

0683-normal.flavor_text: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
0683-normal.name: Aromatisse

0684-normal.flavor_text: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

0685-normal.flavor_text: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
0685-normal.name: Slurpuff

0686-normal.flavor_text: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

0686-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
0686-normal-shadow.name: Inkay (Shadow)

0687-mega.flavor_text: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
0687-mega.name: Malamar (Mega)

0687-normal.flavor_text: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
0687-normal.name: Malamar

0687-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
0687-normal-shadow.name: Malamar (Shadow)

0688-normal.name: Binacle

0689-normal.flavor_text: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
0689-normal.name: Barbaracle

0690-normal.flavor_text: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
0690-normal.name: Skrelp

0691-normal.flavor_text: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
0691-normal.name: Dragalge

0692-normal.flavor_text: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
0692-normal.name: Clauncher

0693-normal.flavor_text: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
0693-normal.name: Clawitzer

0694-normal.flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
0694-normal.name: Helioptile

0694-normal-shadow.flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
0694-normal-shadow.name: Helioptile (Shadow)

0695-normal.flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

0695-normal-shadow.flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
0695-normal-shadow.name: Heliolisk (Shadow)

0696-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
0696-normal.name: Tyrunt

0696-normal-shadow.flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
0696-normal-shadow.name: Tyrunt (Shadow)

0697-normal.flavor_text: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
0697-normal.name: Tyrantrum

0697-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
0697-normal-shadow.name: Tyrantrum (Shadow)

0698-normal.flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
0698-normal.name: Amaura

0698-normal-shadow.flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
0698-normal-shadow.name: Amaura (Shadow)

0699-normal.flavor_text: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
0699-normal.name: Aurorus

0699-normal-shadow.flavor_text: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
0699-normal-shadow.name: Aurorus (Shadow)

0700-normal.flavor_text: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
0700-normal.name: Sylveon

0701-normal.flavor_text: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
0701-normal.name: Hawlucha

0702-normal.flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

0703-normal.name: Carbink

0704-normal.flavor_text: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

0706-normal.name: Goodra

0707-normal.flavor_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
0707-normal.name: Klefki

0708-normal-shadow.flavor_text: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
0708-normal-shadow.name: Phantump (Shadow)

0709-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
0709-normal-shadow.name: Trevenant (Shadow)

0713-normal.flavor_text: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
0713-normal.name: Avalugg

0714-normal-shadow.flavor_text: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
0714-normal-shadow.name: Noibat (Shadow)

0715-normal.name: Noivern

0715-normal-shadow.flavor_text: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
0715-normal-shadow.name: Noivern (Shadow)

0716-normal.name: Xerneas

0717-normal.flavor_text: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
0717-normal.name: Yveltal

0718-10-forme.flavor_text: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
0718-10-forme.name: Zygarde (10% Forme)

0718-50-forme.flavor_text: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
0718-50-forme.name: Zygarde (50% Forme)

0718-complete-forme.flavor_text: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
0718-complete-forme.name: Zygarde (Complete Forme)

0719-mega.flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
0719-mega.name: Diancie (Mega)

0719-normal.flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
0719-normal.name: Diancie

0720-confined.flavor_text: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
0720-confined.name: Hoopa (Confined)

0720-normal.flavor_text: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
0720-normal.name: Hoopa

0720-unbound.flavor_text: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
0720-unbound.name: Hoopa (Unbound)

0721-normal.flavor_text: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
0721-normal.name: Volcanion

0722-normal.flavor_text: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.
0722-normal.name: Rowlet

0723-normal.flavor_text: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.
0723-normal.name: Dartrix

0724-hisuian.flavor_text: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.
0724-hisuian.name: Decidueye (Hisuian)

0724-normal.flavor_text: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.
0724-normal.name: Decidueye

0725-normal.flavor_text: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.
0725-normal.name: Litten

0726-normal.flavor_text: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.
0726-normal.name: Torracat

0727-normal.flavor_text: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
0727-normal.name: Incineroar

0728-normal.flavor_text: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!
0728-normal.name: Popplio

0729-normal.flavor_text: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
0729-normal.name: Brionne

0730-normal.flavor_text: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.
0730-normal.name: Primarina

0731-normal.flavor_text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
0731-normal.name: Pikipek

0731-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
0731-normal-shadow.name: Pikipek (Shadow)

0732-normal.flavor_text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
0732-normal.name: Trumbeak

0732-normal-shadow.flavor_text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
0732-normal-shadow.name: Trumbeak (Shadow)

0733-normal.flavor_text: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
0733-normal.name: Toucannon

0733-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
0733-normal-shadow.name: Toucannon (Shadow)

0734-normal.flavor_text: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
0734-normal.name: Yungoos

0735-normal.flavor_text: Patient by nature, this Pokémon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
0735-normal.name: Gumshoos

0736-normal.flavor_text: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
0736-normal.name: Grubbin

0736-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
0736-normal-shadow.name: Grubbin (Shadow)

0737-normal.flavor_text: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
0737-normal.name: Charjabug

0737-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
0737-normal-shadow.name: Charjabug (Shadow)

0738-normal.flavor_text: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
0738-normal.name: Vikavolt

0738-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
0738-normal-shadow.name: Vikavolt (Shadow)

0739-normal.flavor_text: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
0739-normal.name: Crabrawler

0740-normal.flavor_text: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
0740-normal.name: Crabominable

0741-baile.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
0741-baile.name: Oricorio (Baile)

0741-pa-u.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
0741-pa-u.name: Oricorio (Pa'u)

0741-pom-pom.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
0741-pom-pom.name: Oricorio (Pom-Pom)

0741-sensu.flavor_text: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
0741-sensu.name: Oricorio (Sensu)

0742-normal.flavor_text: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes' movements and make fools of them.
0742-normal.name: Cutiefly

0743-normal.flavor_text: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
0743-normal.name: Ribombee

0744-normal.flavor_text: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
0744-normal.name: Rockruff

0745-dusk.flavor_text: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
0745-dusk.name: Lycanroc (Dusk)

0745-midday.flavor_text: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
0745-midday.name: Lycanroc (Midday)

0745-midnight.flavor_text: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
0745-midnight.name: Lycanroc (Midnight)

0746-normal.flavor_text: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
0746-normal.name: Wishiwashi

0746-school.flavor_text: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
0746-school.name: Wishiwashi (School)

0746-solo.flavor_text: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
0746-solo.name: Wishiwashi (Solo)

0747-normal.flavor_text: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they're cut off. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.
0747-normal.name: Mareanie

0748-normal.flavor_text: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.
0748-normal.name: Toxapex

0749-normal.flavor_text: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.
0749-normal.name: Mudbray

0750-normal.flavor_text: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
0750-normal.name: Mudsdale

0751-normal.flavor_text: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
0751-normal.name: Dewpider

0751-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
0751-normal-shadow.name: Dewpider (Shadow)

0752-normal.flavor_text: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
0752-normal.name: Araquanid

0752-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
0752-normal-shadow.name: Araquanid (Shadow)

0753-normal.flavor_text: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
0753-normal.name: Fomantis

0754-normal.flavor_text: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.
0754-normal.name: Lurantis

0755-normal.flavor_text: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.
0755-normal.name: Morelull

0756-normal.flavor_text: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
0756-normal.name: Shiinotic

0756-normal-shadow.flavor_text: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
0756-normal-shadow.name: Shiinotic (Shadow)

0757-normal.flavor_text: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda, since it's always reeling.
0757-normal.name: Salandit

0758-normal.flavor_text: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
0758-normal.name: Salazzle

0759-normal.flavor_text: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
0759-normal.name: Stufful

0759-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
0759-normal-shadow.name: Stufful (Shadow)

0760-normal.flavor_text: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.
0760-normal.name: Bewear

0760-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokémon in the Alola region.
0760-normal-shadow.name: Bewear (Shadow)

0761-normal.flavor_text: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It's usually a fruitless attempt.
0761-normal.name: Bounsweet

0762-normal.flavor_text: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They're quite painful when they smack you!
0762-normal.name: Steenee

0763-normal.flavor_text: A Pokémon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.
0763-normal.name: Tsareena

0764-normal.flavor_text: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.
0764-normal.name: Comfey

0765-normal.flavor_text: Oranguru don't get along with each other, so they're always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.
0765-normal.name: Oranguru

0766-normal.flavor_text: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.
0766-normal.name: Passimian

0767-normal.flavor_text: An astonishingly cowardly Pokémon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.
0767-normal.name: Wimpod

0768-normal.flavor_text: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.
0768-normal.name: Golisopod

0769-normal.flavor_text: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
0769-normal.name: Sandygast

0770-normal.flavor_text: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
0770-normal.name: Palossand

0771-normal.flavor_text: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!
0771-normal.name: Pyukumuku

0772-null.flavor_text: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
0772-null.name: Type (Null)

0773-bug.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-bug.name: Silvally (Bug)

0773-dark.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-dark.name: Silvally (Dark)

0773-dragon.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-dragon.name: Silvally (Dragon)

0773-electric.name: Silvally (Electric)

0773-fairy.name: Silvally (Fairy)

0773-fighting.name: Silvally (Fighting)

0773-fire.name: Silvally (Fire)

0773-flying.name: Silvally (Flying)

0773-ghost.name: Silvally (Ghost)

0773-grass.name: Silvally (Grass)
