0773-ground.name: Silvally (Ground)

0773-ice.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-ice.name: Silvally (Ice)

0773-normal.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-normal.name: Silvally

0773-poison.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-poison.name: Silvally (Poison)

0773-psychic.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-psychic.name: Silvally (Psychic)

0773-rock.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-rock.name: Silvally (Rock)

0773-steel.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-steel.name: Silvally (Steel)

0773-water.flavor_text: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
0773-water.name: Silvally (Water)

0774-core.flavor_text: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
0774-core.name: Minior (Core)

0774-meteor.flavor_text: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
0774-meteor.name: Minior (Meteor)

0775-normal.flavor_text: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
0775-normal.name: Komala

0776-normal.flavor_text: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.
0776-normal.name: Turtonator

0777-normal.flavor_text: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
0777-normal.name: Togedemaru

0778-busted.flavor_text: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
0778-busted.name: Mimikyu (Busted)

0778-normal.flavor_text: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokémon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
0778-normal.name: Mimikyu

0779-normal.flavor_text: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
0779-normal.name: Bruxish

0780-normal.flavor_text: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.
0780-normal.name: Drampa

0781-normal.flavor_text: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.
0781-normal.name: Dhelmise

0782-normal.flavor_text: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.
0782-normal.name: Jangmo-o

0783-normal.flavor_text: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.
0783-normal.name: Hakamo-o

0784-normal.flavor_text: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
0784-normal.name: Kommo-o

0785-normal.flavor_text: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
0785-normal.name: Tapu Koko

0786-normal.flavor_text: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
0786-normal.name: Tapu Lele

0787-normal.flavor_text: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.
0787-normal.name: Tapu Bulu

0788-normal.flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
0788-normal.name: Tapu Fini

0789-normal.flavor_text: Whether or not it's a Pokémon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.
0789-normal.name: Cosmog

0790-normal.flavor_text: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
0790-normal.name: Cosmoem

0791-normal.flavor_text: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name “the beast that devours the sun."
0791-normal.name: Solgaleo

0792-normal.flavor_text: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
0792-normal.name: Lunala

0793-normal.flavor_text: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokémon.
0793-normal.name: Nihilego

0794-normal.flavor_text: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.
0794-normal.name: Buzzwole

0795-normal.flavor_text: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
0795-normal.name: Pheromosa

0796-normal.flavor_text: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.
0796-normal.name: Xurkitree

0797-normal.flavor_text: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
0797-normal.name: Celesteela

0798-normal.flavor_text: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
0798-normal.name: Kartana

0799-normal.flavor_text: An unknown life-form called a UB. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
0799-normal.name: Guzzlord

0800-dawn-wings.flavor_text: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
0800-dawn-wings.name: Necrozma (Dawn Wings)

0800-dusk-mane.flavor_text: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
0800-dusk-mane.name: Necrozma (Dusk Mane)

0800-normal.flavor_text: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
0800-normal.name: Necrozma

0800-ultra.flavor_text: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
0800-ultra.name: Necrozma (Ultra)

0801-normal.flavor_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
0801-normal.name: Magearna

0802-normal.flavor_text: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
0802-normal.name: Marshadow

0803-normal.flavor_text: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
0803-normal.name: Poipole

0804-normal.flavor_text: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
0804-normal.name: Naganadel

0805-normal.flavor_text: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.
0805-normal.name: Stakataka

0806-normal.flavor_text: A UB that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.
0806-normal.name: Blacephalon

0807-normal.flavor_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
0807-normal.name: Zeraora

0808-normal.flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
0808-normal.name: Meltan

0809-normal.flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
0809-normal.name: Melmetal

0810-normal.flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
0810-normal.name: Grookey

0811-normal.flavor_text: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
0811-normal.name: Thwackey

0812-normal.flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
0812-normal.name: Rillaboom

0813-normal.flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
0813-normal.name: Scorbunny

0814-normal.flavor_text: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
0814-normal.name: Raboot

0815-normal.flavor_text: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
0815-normal.name: Cinderace

0816-normal.flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
0816-normal.name: Sobble

0817-normal.flavor_text: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
0817-normal.name: Drizzile

0818-normal.flavor_text: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
0818-normal.name: Inteleon

0819-normal.flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
0819-normal.name: Skwovet

0820-normal.flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
0820-normal.name: Greedent

0821-normal.flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
0821-normal.name: Rookidee

0821-normal-shadow.flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
0821-normal-shadow.name: Rookidee (Shadow)

0822-normal.flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
0822-normal.name: Corvisquire

0822-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
0822-normal-shadow.name: Corvisquire (Shadow)

0823-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
0823-normal.name: Corviknight

0823-normal-shadow.flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
0823-normal-shadow.name: Corviknight (Shadow)

0824-normal.flavor_text: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.
0824-normal.name: Blipbug

0825-normal.flavor_text: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
0825-normal.name: Dottler

0826-normal.flavor_text: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
0826-normal.name: Orbeetle

0827-normal.flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
0827-normal.name: Nickit

0828-normal.flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
0828-normal.name: Thievul

0829-normal.flavor_text: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
0829-normal.name: Gossifleur

0830-normal.flavor_text: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
0830-normal.name: Eldegoss

0831-normal.flavor_text: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
0831-normal.name: Wooloo

0832-normal.flavor_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
0832-normal.name: Dubwool

0833-normal.flavor_text: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
0833-normal.name: Chewtle

0834-normal.flavor_text: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
0834-normal.name: Drednaw

0835-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
0835-normal.name: Yamper

0836-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
0836-normal.name: Boltund

0837-normal.flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
0837-normal.name: Rolycoly

0838-normal.flavor_text: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
0838-normal.name: Carkol

0839-normal.flavor_text: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
0839-normal.name: Coalossal

0840-normal.flavor_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
0840-normal.name: Applin

0841-normal.flavor_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
0841-normal.name: Flapple

0842-normal.flavor_text: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
0842-normal.name: Appletun

0843-normal.flavor_text: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
0843-normal.name: Silicobra

0844-normal.flavor_text: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
0844-normal.name: Sandaconda

0845-normal.flavor_text: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
0845-normal.name: Cramorant

0846-normal.flavor_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
0846-normal.name: Arrokuda

0847-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
0847-normal.name: Barraskewda

0848-normal.flavor_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
0848-normal.name: Toxel

0849-amped.flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
0849-amped.name: Toxtricity (Amped)

0849-low-key.flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
0849-low-key.name: Toxtricity (Low Key)

0849-normal.flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
0849-normal.name: Toxtricity

0850-normal.flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
0850-normal.name: Sizzlipede

0851-normal.flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
0851-normal.name: Centiskorch

0852-normal.flavor_text: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
0852-normal.name: Clobbopus

0853-normal.flavor_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
0853-normal.name: Grapploct

0854-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
0854-normal.name: Sinistea

0855-normal.flavor_text: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
0855-normal.name: Polteageist

0856-normal.flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
0856-normal.name: Hatenna

0857-normal.flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
0857-normal.name: Hattrem

0858-normal.flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
0858-normal.name: Hatterene

0859-normal.flavor_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
0859-normal.name: Impidimp

0860-normal.flavor_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
0860-normal.name: Morgrem

0861-normal.flavor_text: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
0861-normal.name: Grimmsnarl

0862-normal.flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
0862-normal.name: Obstagoon

0862-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
0862-normal-shadow.name: Obstagoon (Shadow)

0863-normal.flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
0863-normal.name: Perrserker

0864-normal.flavor_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
0864-normal.name: Cursola

0865-normal.flavor_text: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
0865-normal.name: Sirfetch'd

0866-normal.flavor_text: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
0866-normal.name: Mr. Rime

0867-normal.flavor_text: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
0867-normal.name: Runerigus

0868-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
0868-normal.name: Milcery

0869-normal.flavor_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
0869-normal.name: Alcremie

0870-mega.flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
0870-mega.name: Falinks (Mega)

0870-normal.flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
0870-normal.name: Falinks

0871-normal.flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
0871-normal.name: Pincurchin

0872-normal.flavor_text: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
0872-normal.name: Snom

0873-normal.flavor_text: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
0873-normal.name: Frosmoth

0874-normal.flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
0874-normal.name: Stonjourner

0875-ice.flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
0875-ice.name: Eiscue (Ice)

0875-noice.flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
0875-noice.name: Eiscue (Noice)

0875-normal.flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
0875-normal.name: Eiscue

0876-female.flavor_text: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
0876-female.name: Indeedee (Female)

0876-male.flavor_text: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
0876-male.name: Indeedee (Male)

0877-full-belly.flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
0877-full-belly.name: Morpeko (Full Belly)

0877-hangry.flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
0877-hangry.name: Morpeko (Hangry)

0878-normal.flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
0878-normal.name: Cufant

0879-normal.flavor_text: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
0879-normal.name: Copperajah

0880-normal.flavor_text: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
0880-normal.name: Dracozolt

0881-normal.flavor_text: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
0881-normal.name: Arctozolt

0882-normal.flavor_text: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
0882-normal.name: Dracovish

0883-normal.flavor_text: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
0883-normal.name: Arctovish

0884-normal.flavor_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
0884-normal.name: Duraludon

0885-normal.flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
0885-normal.name: Dreepy

0886-normal.flavor_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
0886-normal.name: Drakloak

0887-normal.flavor_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
0887-normal.name: Dragapult

0888-crowned-sword.flavor_text: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
0888-crowned-sword.name: Zacian (Crowned Sword)

0888-hero.flavor_text: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
0888-hero.name: Zacian (Hero)

0889-crowned-shield.flavor_text: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
0889-crowned-shield.name: Zamazenta (Crowned Shield)

0889-hero.flavor_text: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
0889-hero.name: Zamazenta (Hero)

0890-eternamax.flavor_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
0890-eternamax.name: Eternatus (Eternamax)

0890-normal.flavor_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
0890-normal.name: Eternatus

0891-normal.flavor_text: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
0891-normal.name: Kubfu

0892-rapid-strike.flavor_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
0892-rapid-strike.name: Urshifu (Rapid Strike)

0892-single-strike.flavor_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
0892-single-strike.name: Urshifu (Single Strike)

0893-normal.flavor_text: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
0893-normal.name: Zarude

0894-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
0894-normal.name: Regieleki

0895-normal.flavor_text: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
0895-normal.name: Regidrago

0896-normal.flavor_text: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
0896-normal.name: Glastrier

0897-normal.flavor_text: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
0897-normal.name: Spectrier

0898-ice-rider.flavor_text: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
0898-ice-rider.name: Calyrex (Ice Rider)

0898-normal.flavor_text: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
0898-normal.name: Calyrex

0899-normal.flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
0899-normal.name: Wyrdeer

0900-normal.flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one’s only recourse is to flee.
0900-normal.name: Kleavor

0901-normal.flavor_text: I believe it was Hisui’s swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
0901-normal.name: Ursaluna

0901-normal-shadow.flavor_text: I believe it was Hisui’s swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
0901-normal-shadow.name: Ursaluna (Shadow)

0902-female.flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui’s rivers is Basculegion’s equal.
0902-female.name: Basculegion (Female)

0902-male.flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui’s rivers is Basculegion’s equal.
0902-male.name: Basculegion (Male)

0903-normal.flavor_text: Because of Sneasler’s virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
0903-normal.name: Sneasler

0903-normal-shadow.flavor_text: Because of Sneasler’s virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
0903-normal-shadow.name: Sneasler (Shadow)

0904-normal.flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
0904-normal.name: Overqwil

0906-normal.flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
0906-normal.name: Sprigatito

0907-normal.flavor_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
0907-normal.name: Floragato

0908-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
0908-normal.name: Meowscarada

0909-normal.flavor_text: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
0909-normal.name: Fuecoco

0910-normal.flavor_text: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
0910-normal.name: Crocalor

0911-normal.flavor_text: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
0911-normal.name: Skeledirge

0912-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
0912-normal.name: Quaxly

0913-normal.flavor_text: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
0913-normal.name: Quaxwell

0914-normal.flavor_text: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
0914-normal.name: Quaquaval

0915-normal.flavor_text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
0915-normal.name: Lechonk

0917-normal.flavor_text: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
0917-normal.name: Tarountula

0918-normal.flavor_text: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
0918-normal.name: Spidops

0919-normal.flavor_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
0919-normal.name: Nymble

0920-normal.flavor_text: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
0920-normal.name: Lokix

0921-normal.flavor_text: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
0921-normal.name: Pawmi

0922-normal.flavor_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
0922-normal.name: Pawmo

0923-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
0923-normal.name: Pawmot

0924-normal.flavor_text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
0924-normal.name: Tandemaus

0926-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
0926-normal.name: Fidough

0927-normal.flavor_text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
0927-normal.name: Dachsbun

0928-normal.flavor_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
0928-normal.name: Smoliv

0929-normal.flavor_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
0929-normal.name: Dolliv

0930-normal.flavor_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
0930-normal.name: Arboliva

0932-normal.flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
0932-normal.name: Nacli

0933-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
0933-normal.name: Naclstack

0934-normal.flavor_text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
0934-normal.name: Garganacl

0935-normal.flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
0935-normal.name: Charcadet

0936-normal.flavor_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
0936-normal.name: Armarouge

0937-normal.flavor_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
0937-normal.name: Ceruledge

0938-normal.flavor_text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
0938-normal.name: Tadbulb

0939-normal.flavor_text: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
0939-normal.name: Bellibolt

0940-normal.flavor_text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
0940-normal.name: Wattrel

0941-normal.flavor_text: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
0941-normal.name: Kilowattrel

0942-normal.flavor_text: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
0942-normal.name: Maschiff

0943-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
0943-normal.name: Mabosstiff

0944-normal.flavor_text: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
0944-normal.name: Shroodle

0945-normal.flavor_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
0945-normal.name: Grafaiai

0946-normal.flavor_text: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
0946-normal.name: Bramblin

0947-normal.flavor_text: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
0947-normal.name: Brambleghast

0948-normal.flavor_text: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
0948-normal.name: Toedscool

0949-normal.flavor_text: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
0949-normal.name: Toedscruel

0950-normal.flavor_text: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
0950-normal.name: Klawf

0951-normal.flavor_text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
0951-normal.name: Capsakid

0952-normal.flavor_text: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
0952-normal.name: Scovillain

0953-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
0953-normal.name: Rellor

0954-normal.flavor_text: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
0954-normal.name: Rabsca

0955-normal.flavor_text: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
0955-normal.name: Flittle

0956-normal.flavor_text: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
0956-normal.name: Espathra

0957-normal.flavor_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
0957-normal.name: Tinkatink

0958-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
0958-normal.name: Tinkatuff

0959-normal.flavor_text: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
0959-normal.name: Tinkaton

0960-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
0960-normal.name: Wiglett

0961-normal.flavor_text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
0961-normal.name: Wugtrio

0962-normal.flavor_text: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
0962-normal.name: Bombirdier

0963-normal.flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
0963-normal.name: Finizen

0965-normal.flavor_text: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
0965-normal.name: Varoom

0966-normal.flavor_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.
0966-normal.name: Revavroom

0967-normal.flavor_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
0967-normal.name: Cyclizar

0968-normal.flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
0968-normal.name: Orthworm

0969-normal.flavor_text: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
0969-normal.name: Glimmet

0970-normal.flavor_text: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
0970-normal.name: Glimmora

0971-normal.flavor_text: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
0971-normal.name: Greavard

0972-normal.flavor_text: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
0972-normal.name: Houndstone

0973-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
0973-normal.name: Flamigo

0974-normal.flavor_text: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
0974-normal.name: Cetoddle

0975-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
0975-normal.name: Cetitan

0976-normal.flavor_text: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
0976-normal.name: Veluza

0977-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
0977-normal.name: Dondozo

0979-normal.flavor_text: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
0979-normal.name: Annihilape

0979-normal-shadow.flavor_text: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
0979-normal-shadow.name: Annihilape (Shadow)

0980-normal.flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
0980-normal.name: Clodsire

0981-normal.flavor_text: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
0981-normal.name: Farigiraf

0983-normal.flavor_text: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
0983-normal.name: Kingambit

0984-normal.flavor_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
0984-normal.name: Greattusk

0985-normal.flavor_text: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
0985-normal.name: Screamtail

0986-normal.flavor_text: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
0986-normal.name: Brutebonnet

0987-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
0987-normal.name: Fluttermane

0988-normal.flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
0988-normal.name: Slitherwing

0989-normal.flavor_text: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
0989-normal.name: Sandyshocks

0990-normal.flavor_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
0990-normal.name: Irontreads

0991-normal.flavor_text: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
0991-normal.name: Ironbundle

0992-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
0992-normal.name: Ironhands

0993-normal.flavor_text: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
0993-normal.name: Ironjugulis

0994-normal.flavor_text: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
0994-normal.name: Ironmoth

0995-normal.flavor_text: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
0995-normal.name: Ironthorns

0996-normal.flavor_text: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
0996-normal.name: Frigibax

0997-normal.flavor_text: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
0997-normal.name: Arctibax

0998-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
0998-normal.name: Baxcalibur

0999-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped into a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to return to the treasure chest it once inhabited.
0999-normal.name: Gimmighoul

1000-normal.flavor_text: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
1000-normal.name: Gholdengo

1001-normal.flavor_text: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
1001-normal.name: Wo-Chien

1002-normal.flavor_text: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
1002-normal.name: Chien-Pao

1003-normal.flavor_text: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
1003-normal.name: Ting-Lu

1004-normal.flavor_text: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
1004-normal.name: Chi-Yu

1005-normal.flavor_text: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
1005-normal.name: Roaringmoon

1006-normal.flavor_text: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
1006-normal.name: Ironvaliant

honesty.doClaim: Ranks and guidance are verified to the 2026-08-14 frozen source packet. The Niantic Game Master inside that packet is dated 2026-04-17: its upstream mirror has not published since, so anything added to the game after that date is not modelled here, except 7 charged moves filled from the WatWowMap masterfile (see honesty.supplementedMoves).
honesty.doNotClaim: Fairy has only eight qualifying released Shadow attackers; empty slots are not Pokémon recommendations. PvP rank-1 stat product is not guaranteed matchup-optimal. Stagger timing is not guaranteed. The gym defender ranking is computed over every eligible form and includes the defender's own charged-move offence, but does not model motivation decay, berries, dodging, or an attacker simply bringing the hard counter. Curated placement notes on 12 of those rows are editorial judgment annotating the ranking, not deciding it. The anti-<type> bands floor out low-scoring, doubly-weak technical resistors (see each band's floorNote) rather than listing every form that merely resists the type, so a handful of literal resistors are absent on purpose. Shadow forms are ranked in a separate list with its own 1..N ranks, not merged into the main ranking or excluded from it: a caught shadow fights on Frustration by default and takes 20% more damage, so its rank answers a different question (what can this specific caught Pokémon hold a gym with) than the main list (what should I go build).

preserve-practical-publish-optimal-v1.rationale: Keep the frozen practical ranking moveset and metric unchanged for auditability while publishing a separate maximum-neutral-DPS legal same-type moveset for standardized comparison.

raidDps.description: Long-run same-type cycle DPS at Level 40 with 15 attack IV. Fast and charged damage are rounded independently for each effectiveness state before cycle damage is divided by cycle time.

FUTURE_SIGHT.rationale: PvPoke uses FUTURE_SIGHT while the frozen Game Master uses FUTURESIGHT for the same PvE move.

PYRO_BALL.rationale: PvPoke uses PYRO_BALL while the frozen Game Master uses PYROBALL for the same PvE move.

TECHNO_BLAST_DOUSE.rationale: PvPoke names Genesect's Douse Drive form TECHNO_BLAST_DOUSE; the frozen Game Master files the same PvE move as TECHNO_BLAST_WATER (its other drives match by type name: BURN/CHILL/SHOCK/NORMAL).

raidDps.practicalMoveCatalogCaveat: No practical recommendation currently lacks frozen move stats. DYNAMAX_CANNON (Eternatus) and GLAIVE_RUSH (Baxcalibur) are Elite-TM-only per data/curated/move-availability.json, so each ranked row headlines its best obtainable same-type moveset and the restricted move is reported as eliteUpgrade. PLASMA_FISTS (Zeraora) was an exception only because the pinned Game Master, dated 2026-04-17, predates the move; the WatWowMap masterfile supplement supplies its stats and the exception was retired.
